source_caption_text:
Follow (us) @Records For More 😂🙏

Bro really said 😦😦😦😦😭

A man showed his friend the GTA 6 trailer during a video call from jail, and his reaction said EVERYTHING 😂🎮 His face when he realized what he was watching is too good.

Now we’re just 5 DAYS away from GTA 6 dropping on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. After all the waiting, trailer breakdowns, and “we got this before GTA 6” jokes, release week is almost here 🤯🔥

It’s been 13 years since GTA 5, and we’re finally about to make another trip to Vice City. Some of us went from asking our parents to buy the last game to taking time off work for this one 😭

Where were you when you first watched the GTA 6 trailer? 👀
